# ITD Database Migration and Security Review Plan

This plan details critical tasks for the IT & Digital department.

## Key Initiatives:

*   Investigate the database migration quarterly.
*   Review the encryption standards urgently.
*   Review the database migration for strategy 2026.
*   Update the database migration urgently.
*   Monitor the firewall settings quarterly.
